svg.text: Simulated devices — the CONTROL UNIT: the remote weapon station and the 9K11 launcher box (SD-S4c, DESIGN_Simulated_Devices §3.13f)
Full colour = SPECIFIED by this mockup · grey dashed + 'unchanged' = CONTEXT, not specified · the picture, the tracers and the target are world effects, illustrative.
specified HUD element (full colour, dark halo — the station's HudText over the view)

Frames are 640 × 360 (16:9), the view riding the selected weapon's sight: the RWS's sight is SLAVED (SightMode = Slaved, D-181 — the cross is the commanded line, the GUN marker the barrel). Layout positions are PROPOSALS where the design is silent.
SELECT steps the weapon in STANDBY or ARMED · ARM needs the selected weapon loaded (D-112) · FIRE per press or held, by the weapon's kind

Every chip is a HudPanel button (D-122): clickable, with its hotkey badge (D-124 — the keys are proposals). The hover frame, the cursor and RMB-LOOK are the virtual adapter's (panels 16–19). For a console the look IS the lay (D-151).
The RWS type lists TRACK, RANGE and the RNG switch beside the base chips (D-172, D-174, D-181) — which controls exist is type data; the 9K11 box lists none of them.
20 · RWS CONSOLE, ARMED — the slaved sight, the cross and the GUN marker (dv-rws-mg)
Scope: the slaved sight's view with the cross, the GUN marker, ammo, the aim readout, RANGE, the MODE and RNG
switches, ZOOM, the lamp, the TRACK / RANGE chips and the six base chips. The compass and the unit lines are context.
READY when the GUN marker reaches the cross
the ARMED chip (green) · the selected weapon's lines: name, AMMO, and AZ / EL of the ACTUAL aim (the
replicated `TurretPose`) · the cross: the slaved sight head's own line, the COMMANDED direction
(`FireControl.LayDir`) · the GUN marker: where the barrel actually points (the replicated `TurretPose`)
against the cross — the gun is still turning toward it · RANGE under the cross with its mode word, the RNG
switch on AUTO (RANGE greyed, nothing to latch), TRACK pressable · the MODE switch (D-157): its three
positions SINGLE · BURST · AUTO with the set one lit, BURST here, and its hotkey badge · the lamp
relabelled SLEWING (amber) until the gun is on the cross, then READY · ZOOM 4× · SELECT greyed (one
weapon), VIEW greyed (a gun has no flight to watch)
the compass · the unit lines · the picture and the truck (the weapon's camera, world)
The RWS's sight is SLAVED (`SightMode = Slaved`, D-181): the picture is the sight head's own line, so the operator sees the
cross move at once and the GUN marker follow with the drives' lag, converging on the cross as the turret arrives. (The simple
box / TV launcher keeps `SightMode = OnWeapon`, D-152, panel 22: its reticle is the barrel.) The stick commands a slew RATE,
MODE is a latching switch (D-157): a click or its hotkey steps it, and beside a replica the replica's rotary owns it and this
switch is display-only (D-135). SINGLE = one round per FIRE press, BURST = one burst per press at the weapon's own burst
length (CE-11033), AUTO = while FIRE is held; the message line follows the mode.
PROPOSAL: the weapon lines, the AZ / EL readout, the switch's place and look, the markers' look, the RNG switch's place, the
aim-chip row, the corner brackets and the layout are mine; the design names what the HUD shows, not where.
21 · RWS CONSOLE, FIRING — AUTO, FIRE held, the ammo counting down (dv-rws-mg, dv-rws-modes)
Scope: the MODE switch on AUTO, the FIRING lamp, FIRE set, the ammo falling, the GUN marker converged on the
cross, the message. Tracers and impacts are world effects.
AUTO — FIRE held, release to stop
the MODE switch on AUTO (the only position that fires while FIRE is held) · the lamp turned red and
relabelled FIRING (`FireControl.Trigger` held) · the FIRE chip set (blue) while the key or the button is
down · AMMO falling (amber below a quarter) · the GUN marker nearly on the cross: the gun has arrived,
RANGE and the RNG switch as panel 20 · 'FIRING' with the release hint
the compass · the unit lines · the tracers and the impacts on the truck (the rounds, world)
On BURST the same FIRE press would fire ONE burst of the weapon's own burst length and stop by itself, on SINGLE one
round, with no FIRING state held (D-157). The weapon's OWN brain fires — the console only raises `Trigger` or moves
PROPOSAL: the amber ammo threshold (a quarter of the belt) and the FIRING relabel are mine; the design names the held
22 · THE 9K11 BOX, ARMED — four launcher lamps, SELECT (dv-remote-launcher, dv-box-two-launchers)
Scope: the box's own sight (GuideFrom = Self), the launcher lamps with the selected one framed, ARMED, READY, the six
chips. The flight itself is panel 11 — the same box, GUIDING.
SELECT steps the launcher · FIRE launches
the box's name and the ARMED chip · the LAUNCHER lamps: 1 spent (greyed, crossed), 2 loaded and
SELECTED (gold frame), 3 loaded, 4 not connected (dashed) · the READY lamp for the selected launcher ·
'LAUNCHER 2 READY' · the MODE switch GREYED on SINGLE (a launcher offers SINGLE only, D-157) ·
SELECT pressable (steps 2 → 3), FIRE pressable, VIEW greyed until a round flies
the compass · the unit lines · the picture and the tank
The box commands up to four uncrewed launchers on cables (D-155); each `Selected` index is a launcher of
`ControlledEntities` (D-147). ARM needs the SELECTED launcher loaded (D-154, D-112): selecting the spent launcher 1 would
show NO MISSILE and ARM refused. A press of MODE is refused the same way (D-157): a per-press weapon has one mode.
The view is the box's own sight, not the launcher's camera (`GuideFrom = Self`, D-153): the round flies the line of the sight
he looks through, so the reticle is the guide line, as for the TOW sight unit (panel 8).
D-156 lists this panel as 'ARMED, a guided flight'; the flight half is drawn as panel 11 (the same chrome: lamp 1 in flight,
SELECT refused, the stick gauge) so the two do not repeat each other.
PROPOSAL: the lamp strip's place and look, the 8× field and the hotkeys are mine.
23 · RWS CONSOLE, PAUSED — FIRE and the lay held, the view still answers (dv-rws-paused)
Scope: the same HUD in pause: FIRE greyed, the cross and the GUN marker held where they were (the stick is ignored),
MODE and ZOOM still acting. The toolbar's paused state is context.
MODE · RNG · ZOOM · SELECT · VIEW still act; TRACK waits
the READY lamp off and FIRE greyed (a world effect is refused in pause, never queued — D-78, D-154) ·
TRACK greyed (D-180: a lock is a write, it waits for a live frame) while RANGE stays pressable (a latch of
the measured range is device state, shown, nothing flies) and the RNG switch stepped to HOLD in pause ·
the GUN marker held, tagged HELD, while the stick is swung (the gun does not turn, the cross does not
move) — the lay is integrated on live frames only (D-151) · the MODE switch stepped to SINGLE in pause,
tagged 'set in pause' (MODE is device state, nothing fires — D-157) · ZOOM 8× changed in pause and the
picture magnified (observation) · the message 'FIRE HELD IN PAUSE'
the toolbar's run controls (paused) · the compass · the unit lines · the picture
Judged by dv-rws-paused: FIRE held through a pause and the stick swung hard — ⛔ `never` a shot during the pause, the turret
pose unchanged. Nothing turns, nothing fires; on resume the lay continues from where it was held.
No in-view PAUSED banner (as panels 5 and 15): the toolbar is the pause cue. PROPOSAL: the HELD tag and the message's
words are mine; the design says the lay, the lock and the trigger are frozen, not how the HUD shows it.
